theorem certifiedClass_allScreens (screen : UiScreen)
    (accepted : accepts (screenShape screen) = true) (v : Size) (hv : v ∈ viewports) :
    ∃ painted, paint screen v = some painted ∧ Realizes screen v painted
theorems.Ehr.Layout.Shell.certified_currentCommit:
theorem certified_currentCommit_visible (screen : UiScreen)
    (accepted : accepts (screenShape screen) = true) (slot : SlotShape)
    (member : slot ∈ screenShape screen) (current : slot.region = .footer) :
    ∃ painted, paint screen ⟨92160,57600⟩ = some painted ∧
      ∃ d ∈ painted, d.box.info.source = some slot.path ∧ d.box.info.commit = true ∧
        d.box.info.target = true ∧ visible ⟨92160,57600⟩ d.box
theorems.Ehr.Layout.Range.renderer_range:
theorem renderer_range (sp : Ehr.Spec) (program : Ehr.Program) (facts : Ehr.Facts)
    (display : Display) (user : Ehr.User) (state : Ehr.State) :
    Shell.accepts (screenShape (runRenderUi ⟨sp,program,facts,display,user,state⟩)) = true
theorems.Ehr.Layout.Range.checkProgram_sound:
theorem checkProgram_sound (sp : Ehr.Spec) (program : Ehr.Program)
    (_accepted : checkProgram sp program = true) : RenderCovered sp program Library.fixedShell
theorems.Ehr.Layout.Range.checkProgram_allStates:
theorem checkProgram_allStates (sp : Ehr.Spec) (program : Ehr.Program)
    (_accepted : checkProgram sp program = true) :
    ∀ (facts : Ehr.Facts) (display : Display) (user : Ehr.User) (state : Ehr.State),
      ∀ v ∈ viewports, ∃ painted,
        uncheckedPaint (runRenderUi ⟨sp,program,facts,display,user,state⟩) v = some painted ∧
        Realizes (runRenderUi ⟨sp,program,facts,display,user,state⟩) v painted
theorems.Ehr.Layout.Range.layoutAccepted_program:
theorem layoutAccepted_program (sp : Ehr.Spec) (program : Ehr.Program)
    (accepted : checkProgram sp program = true) :
    ∀ (facts : Ehr.Facts) (display : Display) (user : Ehr.User) (state : Ehr.State),
      Ehr.Props.Reachable ⟨sp,program,facts,user⟩ state →
      ∀ v ∈ viewports, ∃ painted,
        uncheckedPaint (runRenderUi ⟨sp,program,facts,display,user,state⟩) v = some painted ∧
        Realizes (runRenderUi ⟨sp,program,facts,display,user,state⟩) v painted
